reviews.text: We have been bringing our scratch to this establishment for almost 10 years and we have always had a great experience.

Oh my God, never again!!!!!!!!! With my poor little Scitzu, I don't know what he did! He doesn't know anything!!!!!! Highly not recommended! He charged 50 euros for what?? I would have cut his fur better! Dog still full of knots!
I recommend it, the price and quality are top 👍 …

Excellent experience.
Very competent, excellent result.
Kind person and loves animals, excellent grooming
